failure_mode: Missed / mislocated hotspot, false alarm: sun glint or poor sensor angle corrupts the thermal image
effect: Defective module missed (energy loss, fire risk) or healthy module sent for repair
mitigation: glint-risk model picks mast height with the lowest specular risk; pixels within 10 deg of the mirror direction are masked; verification view at another height
shown_in: src/solar_defect_detector.py _choose_lift / defect_detection.py glint mask; analytics/run_scenarios.py glint_stress
S_basis: undetected hot cell can lead to module loss / fire (judgement)
D_basis: baseline has no check (D=8); proposed raises RECHECK and a second view, so the error is usually caught before geotagging (D=4)

failure_mode: AMR drifts into inter-row gap or kerb (localisation drift)
effect: Collision with kerb / module frame, mission aborted, equipment damage
mitigation: side range-pair feedback on the module plane + surveyed fiducials every 5 modules replace pure dead reckoning
S_basis: contact with a live PV row can damage glass / robot (judgement)
D_basis: baseline can only see the error when it hits something (D=7); proposed measures lateral gap every 20 ms (D=3)

failure_mode: Wrong module identified / geotag on the wrong module (dock or odometry offset)
effect: Technician sent to the wrong module; real defect left unrepaired
mitigation: fiducial position fixes (every 5 modules) re-anchor the module index
S_basis: repair effort wasted and defect persists (judgement)
D_basis: no cross-check in baseline (D=8); proposed re-anchors at each fiducial (D=4)

failure_mode: Thermal assessment made below the valid irradiance (low sun / cloud)
effect: Temperature excess misread: false alarms or missed defects
mitigation: reference-cell irradiance gate (>= 600 W/m2, to be checked against IEC TS 62446-3 Table 3), wait-and-retry, abort and reschedule
D_basis: baseline never checks irradiance (D=7); proposed refuses to assess (D=2)

failure_mode: Thermal sensor noise, spikes or frame drop-outs
effect: False alarms from single hot pixels / missed anomalies from lost frames
mitigation: 3-frame temporal median, cluster (>=2 pixel) rule, repeat on dropout
D_basis: baseline trusts one frame (D=7); proposed median rejects spikes (D=3)

mitigation: optical shadow score + hot-cluster coincidence rule classifies SHADOW_CONFOUNDER
D_basis: baseline has no optical cross-check (D=7); proposed has one (D=3)
